in_sanskrit.name: Bikky
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bold, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bikky एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bik', meaning 'to shine' or 'to be powerful'. This name is associated with the god Vishnu and his avatar, Bhikshatana, who embodies the qualities of strength, courage, and generosity.
